soil: Well-drained loam or clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5
water_requirement: 4-6 irrigations. Critical stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 21 days), Tillering (40-45 days), Jointing (60-65 days), Flowering (80-85 days), Milking (100-105 days), Dough stage (115-120 days). CRI irrigation is most critical.
fertilizer_general: 120 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 40 kg K2O per hectare. Apply full P & K plus 1/3rd N as basal at sowing. Top dress remaining N in two equal splits at 1st and 2nd irrigations.
common_issues: Yellow rust (Puccinia striiformis) appearing as yellow pustules in stripes on leaves; Zinc deficiency (khaira-like chlorosis on 3rd/4th leaf from top); Termite damage in sandy soils.

soil: Clayey or heavy loam soils capable of holding standing water, pH 5.5-7.0
water_requirement: Needs standing water (2-5 cm) during early tillering and panicle initiation. Avoid deep submergence during flowering. Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) saves 25-30% water without yield reduction.
fertilizer_general: 100-120 kg N : 50-60 kg P2O5 : 40-50 kg K2O per hectare. Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate in zinc-deficient soils. Top dress Urea in 3 splits.
common_issues: Blast (Pyricularia oryzae) showing spindle-shaped spots with grey centers; Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) causing hopper burn; Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB) showing wavy yellow-white margins on leaves.

soil: Sandy loam to loamy soil, good drainage, pH 6.5-7.5
water_requirement: 2-3 irrigations. 1st at flowering (30-35 days), 2nd at pod development (60-65 days). Avoid heavy flooding.
fertilizer_general: 60-80 kg N : 40 kg P2O5 : 20-40 kg K2O per hectare. Crucially requires 20-30 kg/ha Sulphur (via Gypsum or Bentonite Sulphur) to enhance oil content.
common_issues: Mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) sucking sap from flowering buds and pods; White rust (Albugo candida) causing white pustules on underside of leaves.

soil: Deep, fertile loam or silt loam, rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5. Susceptible to waterlogging.
water_requirement: Requires 500-600 mm water. Critical stages: Tasseling and Silking. Waterlogging for even 24 hours can reduce yield significantly.
fertilizer_general: 120 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 40-60 kg K2O per hectare. Split nitrogen: 1/4th at sowing, 1/2 at knee-high stage, 1/4th at tasseling.
common_issues: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) damaging central whorl leaves with pinholes and sawdust-like frass.

soil: Loose, friable sandy loam rich in organic matter, pH 5.2-6.5
water_requirement: Frequent light irrigations (every 7-10 days). Never submerge the ridges. Stop irrigation 10-12 days before harvesting to allow skin curing.
fertilizer_general: 150-180 kg N : 80-100 kg P2O5 : 100-120 kg K2O per hectare. Potassium is vital for tuber size and starch quality.
common_issues: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) causing water-soaked dark lesions during foggy, cool, humid weather; Early blight causing concentric rings (target spots).
